description: This file declares the GstProtectionMetadataWrapper class, which implements the IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper interface for managing protection metadata in GStreamer buffers within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps GStreamer protection metadata handling, implementing the IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper interface.

methods.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with a shared pointer to an IGstWrapper instance.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a GStreamer buffer.

methods.name: getProtectionMetadataData
methods.description: Retrieves protection metadata data from a GStreamer buffer.

methods.name: removeProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Removes protection metadata from a GStreamer buffer.
